scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.dev:local: pnpm run build:web && wrangler dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --var ENVIRONMENT:local --var GATEWAY_MODE:simulated --var LOCAL_AUTH_ENABLED:true --var LOCAL_AUTH_EMAIL:owner@example.com --var GATEWAY_DOH_ENDPOINT:https://local.cloudflare-gateway.com/dns-query
scripts.test:worker: vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.production.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.unconfigured.config.ts
